name: Ferrick
title: The Company's Tongue
examine: He sits like a man who owns the road and rents it back by the mile. The ledger open in front of him has two columns and no headings.
lines: The road was here before the towns. The Company just collects what it's owed.
Sit, if you're sitting. Stand there, if you like being counted.
Every cart that passes pays somebody. The only question is who.
